description: This file defines a factory function to build RESTful CRUD controllers for Mongoose models with tenant enforcement, including functions for sorting, pagination, caching, payload sanitization, and error handling.

methods.name: validateSort(sort, allowed = ['timestamp', 'created_at', '_id'])
methods.description: Validates and sanitizes sort string against allowed fields, supporting ascending and descending notation.

methods.name: clampLimit(limit, max = 500)
methods.description: Enforces maximum page size limits for list endpoints to prevent excessive data loads.

methods.name: microGet(key)
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the in-memory micro-cache if not expired.

methods.name: microSet(key, payload)
methods.description: Sets a value in the micro-cache with a specified TTL.

methods.name: buildListKey(req, filter, sort, page, limit, skip, explicit)
methods.description: Constructs a stable cache key based on request URL and list request parameters for caching purposes.

methods.name: sanitizePayloadWithTenant(req)
methods.description: Sanitizes incoming create/update payloads by removing client-supplied tenant org fields and injecting tenantId from request context.

methods.name: mergeFilterWithTenant(filter, tenantId)
methods.description: Combines a client filter with enforced tenant filter, removing tenant hints and applying normalization across multiple tenant-related fields.

methods.name: buildCrudController(Model, listDefaultSort = '-timestamp')
methods.description: Main function that builds a standardized, tenant-aware REST controller for a Mongoose model, including list, getById, create, update, and remove methods, managing tenant enforcement, error handling, caching, and diagnostics.
